name: Vengeance of the Highborne
summary: A patron asks you to find Zalfan Moonshadow at Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades. He condemns Zalfan's ties to the Twilight's Hammer and use of stolen arcane knowledge.

sections.title: A Highborne in the Glades
sections.body: A patron points you southeast to Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, where Zalfan Moonshadow has been seen with the Twilight's Hammer. He calls Zalfan a disgrace to the Highborne, accusing him of serving fanatics with stolen arcane knowledge. The patron offers generous pay for Zalfan's death.

faq.answer: Zalfan Moonshadow is a Highborne seen at Krol'dok Stronghold with the Twilight's Hammer.
Zalfan has been seen at Krol'dok Stronghold in the Riverglades, southeast of here.

faq.q: Why does the patron want Zalfan dead?
faq.answer: The patron says Zalfan brings shame to the Highborne by consorting with the Twilight's Hammer and using stolen arcane knowledge in their service.
The patron offers generous pay to anyone who kills Zalfan Moonshadow.
